anomalies.description: Two men engage in a close-quarters physical confrontation: one grabs the other's arm and torso, then shoves him backward; the second man retaliates with a punch to the first man's face.; James Bond (Daniel Craig) engages in a physical confrontation with another man inside a modern building; frames show pointing, grabbing, and aggressive posturing consistent with a fight initiation and escalation.

Simultaneous with the abduction, a second man is seen struggling near the front of the vehicle, suggesting a concurrent physical struggle involving multiple parties.

A man in the snow aims a handgun at another man who is facing away; muzzle flash or recoil is not visible, but the posture and weapon orientation confirm active aiming/firing stance.
